lines.zh: 我每走一步，脚下亮一下
lines.en: Each step I take leaves a glow

lines.zh: 我身上的裂纹里流着光
lines.en: Light runs through the cracks in me

lines.zh: 晶体腿压弯了脚下的碎石。
lines.en: My crystal legs crush the gravel beneath.

lines.zh: 我朝那股活气的方向走
lines.en: I walk toward that living warmth

lines.zh: 我的晶体外壳擦着石头响
lines.en: My crystal shell scrapes the stone

lines.zh: 我抬手，碎屑从指尖落下
lines.en: I raise a hand and shards fall from my fingers
I skirt the edge of the originium vein
My steps make the grass wilt
I press closer inch by inch
I stop and the cracks open
I walk over from the vein
The light in me grows brighter
I stand and the light travels inside me
The crystals on me are growing
I stand at the mine mouth without blinking.

lines.zh: 我脚下的土变成了灰白
lines.en: The soil at my feet turns ashen
I'm charging here

lines.zh: 我抬起手，看自己的手指
lines.en: I raise a hand and study my own fingers
I hear the ore humming far off
I breathe slowly, without lungs

lines.zh: 地上的影子被我照亮了
lines.en: I light up my own shadow
I wait for someone to come first
You've come up against my vein
The light in me turns your way
You shouldn't have touched that ore
You carry the sweet reek of originium.
One of my fingers lifts
Charging complete. The originium hums.

lines.zh: 我这样站着，你就不敢动
lines.en: Standing like this keeps you still
There's no originium in your blood yet
I lift my other hand too
Running won't help
A piece of crystal falls off me
The light dims and comes back
I step back and the ground crumbles
The cracks in me widen
I didn't make a sound
I press a hand to the wound
Shards scatter on the ground
I'm brighter, and less steady
I pause to charge again
I'm still standing here
That ore is mine
You're holding what you shouldn't
Light draws me over
I shift half a step your way
Put it down and I'll let you go
I can hear it calling
You're gripping it too tight

lines.zh: 它已经开始长进你手里
lines.en: It's already growing into your hand
Come a little closer
I'll take it back
You hit me like striking rock
I haven't shifted at all
My hand pushes you off

lines.zh: 你的肩磕在我的晶体上
lines.en: Your shoulder knocks my crystal

lines.zh: 充能的碎屑，落了你一身。
lines.en: Charged dust settles all over you.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，光暗了一下
lines.en: I step back and the light dims
You go around my flank
We meet with a brittle crack
I raise an arm to block

lines.zh: 这一下不算冲突，只是试
lines.en: That wasn't a clash, only a test

lines.zh: 矿脉那头有另一个亮着的东西
lines.en: Another glowing thing stands at the vein
We light each other
Its crystals are more orderly than mine

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，地面发白
lines.en: We stand side by side and the ground pales
Its light is dimmer
We raise a hand each
It charges, and so do I
Two together ring louder
Between us there's no need for words
This vein has enough for two
I bend my crystalline body to take it
This ore recognizes me.

lines.zh: 它和我身上的东西同源
lines.en: It's the same stuff as me
I press it into my palm
It dissolves in my hand
The cracks in me brighten
I'll keep this one
It's too broken to be useful
I put it back into the vein
You shouldn't have seen this
You picked up that ore
The light in me goes white
The ground begins to crack
The light in me has you fixed

lines.zh: 你身上已经有了源石的味道
lines.en: You already smell of originium
I pace toward you, step by step

lines.zh: 你踩碎的石子，我全听见。
lines.en: Every pebble you crunch, I hear.
You don't want to know what's next
This is the vein's territory
I won't let you take it
My whole body is humming
You can't run now
I've begun charging
All of this belongs to the vein
Did you hear it
I'm going to keep you here
I brighten as I walk

lines.zh: 地上留下我踩出的白痕
lines.en: White marks trail from my steps
You're retreating deeper into the vein
There's more originium there
I raise a hand and light gathers
Your breathing is getting heavy

lines.zh: 空气里有细小的晶体在飘
lines.en: Fine crystals drift in the air
You cough, muffling it
I wait for you to breathe more of it
The whole vein is awake now
Cracks spread from my feet
You've backed against the vein wall
At the tunnel's end, I am waiting.
I stop and watch you

lines.zh: 这个间距正好够我动手
lines.en: This gap is exactly enough

lines.zh: 我身上充着源石的能量。
lines.en: Originium energy charges through me.

lines.zh: 我的光已经爬到你脚边。
lines.en: My glow has already crawled to your feet.
I won't be hurried
The originium will do the work
You belong here now

lines.zh: 掌心的晶体扎进你肩膀。
lines.en: The crystal in my palm bites into your shoulder.
It lands on your chest

lines.zh: 我的手指划过你的护甲
lines.en: My fingers drag across your armor
You're thrown against the vein wall
I seize your arm
Shards burst from my palm

lines.zh: 这一下打空了，石头碎了
lines.en: I miss and the stone shatters
I come back with a backhand
You retreat onto originium

lines.zh: 我的拳头砸在地上，地裂开了
lines.en: My fist craters the ground

lines.zh: 你挡住，手臂上结了一层晶
lines.en: You block and crystal forms on your arm

lines.zh: 我揪住你的衣领往上拎
lines.en: I haul you up by the collar
That one landed heavy

lines.zh: 这一下震得你护甲变形。
lines.en: This blow warps your armor out of shape.
I never paused once
You're starting to glow too
I drive my shoulder into your chest
I'm knocked back and set my feet again

lines.zh: 这一下带着晶体撞过来
lines.en: This one comes with crystal behind it
You're swept aside
Something glows deep in the vein
I rise out of the ore pile
Every crack in me lights up

lines.zh: 地面上的源石跟着我一起亮
lines.en: The originium on the ground lights with me
Fine dust hangs in the air
I walk out of the vein step by step
This vein has grown too full
Something living came near, and I woke
I raise a hand and shards fall
My shadow bleaches the ground

lines.zh: 我抬起眼，光从里面出来
lines.en: I lift my eyes and the light comes out
The vein answers me

lines.zh: 火烤着我的晶体，它开始发白
lines.en: Fire bakes my crystal and it goes white

lines.zh: 我从矿壁上摔下，碎了一块
lines.en: I fall from the vein wall and break a piece

lines.zh: 水浸着我，光在水里散开
lines.en: Water soaks me and the light scatters

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，晶体飞了一地
lines.en: The blast throws me down and crystal flies

lines.zh: 箭打在我的晶体上，崩了一角
lines.en: An arrow chips a corner off my crystal

lines.zh: 那股力量和源石撞在一起
lines.en: That force collides with the originium
The vein has dried, and so am I

lines.zh: 雷打进我身体，我整块亮透
lines.en: Lightning enters me and I light up through
No ore here; I can't stand
